textContent.text: Kate got a new kite today. It is blue with gray stripes. It has a long, green tail.
Kate flies her kite by the stream. The tail sways and moves in the wind. A strong breeze hits the kite.
The kite floats away. It gets stuck in a big oak tree.
"Oh, no! I can't reach it! Now what?" moans Kate. She sees a crow in the tree.
"Mr. Crow, can you please help me?" asks Kate.
The crow nods. He uses his beak to free the kite. The kite floats back down to Kate. She cheers!
"Thank you!" Kate yells.
